bounded_comparison.reason: Addresses same-individual compensation across time, psychological connection, whole-life better-off comparison, and a separate restriction on severe/prolonged suffering.
Uses near/far cases to challenge a time-relative-interests account and connect temporal interests to permission; it is not the same compensation question.

narrow_contribution_not_established: The packet does not identify a particular target theory that inconsistently applies stage-interest, life-welfare, and permission rules, nor does it establish a distinct test absent from the nearest source.
claim_limits: This is a bounded comparison, not a global literature review.
No claim that the idea is universally unoriginal or that all related literature has been located.
McMahan source access was metadata/abstract only; Parfit text was not directly read.
The test cases were applied after source reading and were not preregistered blind predictions.
final_gate: Do not advance as a novel standalone thesis. Preserve only as a future research question tied to a named target theory and a clearer account of welfare bearer, psychological threshold, aggregation, and permission.
